about:
Sunergy Systems was founded in Seattle, Washington, in 2005 as an employee-owned solar design and installation company serving the Puget Sound region, including Olympia, Greater Seattle, Kitsap County, and Mount Vernon.

The company specializes in the sales, design, and installation of solar photovoltaic and backup energy storage systems for residential homes. It has completed over 3,000 installations totaling 15 megawatts of capacity. Sunergy Systems holds Washington state electrical contractor license SUNERSI905D4 and general contractor license SUNERSI905DU, and offers battery storage solutions from Franklin WH and Tesla Powerwall alongside EV charging integration.

Its customer base consists of residential homeowners across Pierce, King, Snohomish, and Kitsap counties, as well as South Whidbey Island. The company also serves existing customers and referrals in surrounding areas.

Sunergy Systems emphasizes its employee-owned structure, award-winning installation expertise, best-in-class product warranties, and a sustainability-focused operation. It promotes panels rated highly for durability and cost-effectiveness, and positions local expertise and post-installation support as key differentiators.
